column1: # The MVS instances on mvsdev.lan, and which of them a tool may submit to.
# This file exists because cc370 captured an oracle deck on port 8080 on
# 2026-09-10. That is MVSCE-DEV, Mike's development machine, and it is off
# limits -- but nothing in either repository said so. cc370 has no .env and
# neither does mvs38src, so a tool needing a target borrows the nearest one,
# and mvsmf/.env points at 8080 because that is correct FOR MVSMF. The rule
# lived in one agent's head while every configuration in reach pointed the
# other way. A prohibition nobody can read is not a control.
# submit=no means: do not send work there. Reading may still be wrong -- see
# the note column -- but submitting is never right.
